ModMetaData.name: Research Requires Resources
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Research Requires Resources makes research a tangible colony investment. Projects with material costs need a one-time funding bundle before research can begin. When you select one, colonists automatically deliver the required resources to a research bench; the Research tab shows delivery progress, reserved items, and funding status. Once the bundle is paid, the project uses vanilla research points as normal.
